bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
cid=gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1
src=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/create-videobot
base=c22ffc587781874ef463c2d912774376fb4e55a8
head=807cea978e88b04cffbc27eb4497183671ac79cf
root=/home/gace/.local/share/gace-create-videobot/native-sticker-c8c50d420c0b9b5d447a1fc87ef3d9e1ec7aceed
target="$root/.releases/$head/video-threeway-conflict-scan"
test "$(docker inspect "$cid" --format '{{.State.Running}}' 2>/dev/null)" = true || exit 61
test -z "$(docker ps --filter label=com.docker.compose.project=gace-createvdobot --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=videobot-poll -q | sed -n '2p')" || exit 62
test "$(git -C "$src" rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = "$head" || exit 63
test ! -e "$target" || exit 64
mkdir -p "$target/ours/src/telegram" "$target/base/src/telegram" "$target/theirs/src/telegram" "$target/merged/src/telegram"
mask=0; bit=1
for p in src/telegram/creatorWizard.mjs src/telegram/creatorUi.mjs src/telegram/paidListingPublisher.mjs src/telegram/salesPanel.mjs;do
 docker cp "$cid:/opt/videobot/$p" "$target/ours/$p" || exit 65
 git -C "$src" show "$base:$p" > "$target/base/$p" || exit 66
 git -C "$src" show "$head:$p" > "$target/theirs/$p" || exit 67
 if git merge-file -p "$target/ours/$p" "$target/base/$p" "$target/theirs/$p" > "$target/merged/$p";then
  echo "VIDEO_MERGE_$bit=PASS"
 else
  rc=$?
  test "$rc" -ge 1 && test "$rc" -le 127 || exit 68
  grep -q '^<<<<<<< ' "$target/merged/$p" || exit 69
  echo "VIDEO_MERGE_$bit=CONFLICT"
  mask=$((mask+bit))
 fi
 bit=$((bit*2))
done
test "$(docker inspect "$cid" --format '{{.State.Running}}')" = true || exit 70
test "$mask" -gt 0 || exit 71
echo "VIDEO_MERGE_CONFLICT_SET_RECORDED=YES"
exit $((90+mask))
